# hpe_morpheus_subnet_type (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_subnet_type" "example" {
  id = 6
}
```

```terraform
data "hpe_morpheus_subnet_type" "example" {
  name = "VLAN"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the subnet type
- `name` (String) The name of the subnet type

### Read-Only

- `can_assign_pool` (Boolean) Whether a network pool can be assigned to this subnet type
- `code` (String) The code identifier of the subnet type
- `creatable` (Boolean) Whether subnets of this type can be created
- `deletable` (Boolean) Whether subnets of this type can be deleted
- `description` (String) A description of the subnet type
- `dhcp_server_editable` (Boolean) Whether the DHCP server setting is editable for this subnet type
